annotations.title: Prepare mastering of the full song

description: Creates a new song named after the file the person checked in the studio and returns a short-lived ticket for uploading it, so the studio can upload and master the full song. The studio calls this tool when the person chooses to master the full song; the assistant does not need to call it directly.

genre.description: Genre of the song. rock_indie = rock / indie; pop = pop; acoustic = acoustic, singer-songwriter; hip_hop_grime = hip hop, rap, trap, grime; electronic = electronic, EDM, house, techno; reggae_dub = reggae / dub; orchestral = orchestral, film score; metal = metal; jazz = jazz; blues = blues; funk_soul = funk / soul / R&B; punk = punk; other = anything else or not sure (balanced, genre-neutral).

name: prepare_full_master
title: Prepare mastering of the full song
